svg.title: Floor Plan: the elevation strip
svg.desc: The sheet turned on its side: the hall in elevation on cyanotype, floor to a ceiling at 4.57 m, with the steel lever at 2.4 m, the pipes at 2.7 m, the windows at 3.5 m and the claw marks at 3.6 m each on a dimension line; a man of 178 cm stands in outline, and beside him the plain dashed outline of the occupant those heights fit, 338 cm.
